L116@P4: There shall be no such defects as scratch, rust, discoloration, leakage which may adversely

L118@P4: 6. Standard Test Conditions
L119@P4: 6.1 Environmental Conditions
L120@P4: Unless otherwise specified, all tests stated in this specification are conducted at
L121@P4: temperature 23±3°C (@RT) and humidity under 65%.
L122@P4: 6.2 Measuring Equipment
L123@P4: (1) Amp-meter and Volt-meter
L124@P4: The amp-meter and volt-meter should have an accuracy of the grade 0.5mA and
L125@P4: mV or higher.
L126@P4: (2) Slide caliper
L127@P4: The slide caliper should have 0.01 mm scale.
L128@P4: (3) Impedance meter
L129@P4: The impedance meter with AC 1kHz should be used.
L130@P4: 7. Characteristics
L131@P4: 7.1 Standard Charge
L132@P4: This "Standard Charge" means charging Cell with charge current of 0.33C (1,749mA)
L133@P4: and constant voltage 4.2V and 0.025C(133mA) cut-off in CV mode at 23°C.
L134@P4: 7.2 Standard Discharge Capacity
L135@P4: The standard discharge capacity is the initial discharge capacity of Cell, which is
L136@P4: measured with discharge current of 0.2C(1,060mA) with 2.50V cut-off at 23°C within 1
L137@P4: hour after the Standard charge.
L138@P4: Standard Discharge Capacity ≥ 5,140mAh
L139@P4: 7.3 Rated Discharge Capacity
L140@P4: The rated discharge capacity is the initial discharge capacity of Cell, which is measured
L141@P4: with discharge current of 1C(5,300mA) with 2.50V cut-off at 23°C within 1 hour after
L142@P4: the Standard charge.
L143@P4: Rated Discharge Capacity ≥ 5,140mAh
L144@P4: 7.4 Initial internal impedance
L145@P4: Initial internal impedance measured at AC 1kHz and SOC 30% (Shipping SOC)
L146@P4-5: Initial internal impedance ≤ 16.0mΩSAMSUNG SDI Confidential Proprietary

L261@P10: Proper Use and Handling of Lithium Ion Cells
L262@P10: See before using lithium-ion cell
L263@P10: This document has been prepared to describe the appropriate cautions and prohibitions,
L264@P10: which the customer should take or employ when the customer uses and handles the lithium
L265@P10: ion cell to be manufactured and supplied by Samsung SDI in order to obtain optimum
L266@P10: performance and safety.
L267@P10: 1. Charging
L268@P10: 1.1 Charging current
L269@P10: Charging current should be less than maximum charge current specified in the product
L270@P10: specification.
L271@P10: 1.2 Charging voltage
L272@P10: Charging should be done by voltage less than that specified in the product
L273@P10: specification.
L274@P10: 1.3 Charging time
L275@P10: Continuous charging under specified voltage does not cause any loss of performance
L276@P10: characteristics. However, the charge timer is recommended to be installed from a
L277@P10: safety consideration, which shuts off further charging at time specified in the product
L278@P10: specification.
L279@P10: 1.4 Charging temperature
L280@P10: Cell should be charged within a range of specified temperatures in the specification.
L281@P10: 1.5 Reverse charging
L282@P10: Cell should be connected, confirming that its poles are correctly aligned. Inverse
L283@P10: charging should be strictly prohibited. If Cell is connected improperly, it may be
L284@P10: damaged.
L285@P10: 2. Discharging
L286@P10: 2.1 Discharging
L287@P10: Cell shall be discharged continuously at less than maximum discharge current specified
L288@P10: in the product specification. In case of the higher discharge current should be set, it
L289@P10: shall be discussed together with SDI.
L290@P10: 2.2 Discharging temperature
L291@P10: 2.2.1 Cell should be discharged within a range of temperatures specified in the product
L292@P10: specification.
L293@P10: 2.2.2 Otherwise, it may cause loss of characteristics.
L294@P10: 2.3 Over-discharging
L295@P10: 2.3.1 The system should be equipped with a device to prevent further discharging
L296@P10: exceeding discharging cut-off voltage specified in the product specification.
L297@P10-11: 2.3.2 Over-discharging may cause loss of performance, characteristics of battery SAMSUNG SDI Confidential Proprietary

L311@P11: 3. Storage
L312@P11: 3.1 Storage conditions
L313@P11: 3.1.1 Cell should be stored within a range of temperatures specified as below*4
L314@P11: *4 Store the battery at 0 ~ 23°C, low humidity (below 65%), no dust and no
L315@P11: corrosive gas atmosphere
L316@P11: 3.1.2 Otherwise, it may cause loss of performance characteristics, leakage and/or rust.
L317@P11: 3.2 Long-term storage
L318@P11: 3.2.1 Cell should be used within a short period after charging because long-term
L319@P11: storage may cause loss of capacity by self-discharging.
L320@P11: 3.2.2 If long-term (but not longer than Warranty Period as set forth in Section 10
L321@P11: (Warranty)) storage is necessary, Cell shall be stored at shipping voltage,
L322@P11: because storage with higher voltage may cause more loss of performance
L323@P11: characteristics.
L324@P11: 3.3 Storage period
L325@P11: Samsung SDI shall not be liable for any defects of Cell after Warranty Period even if
L326@P11: Cell is stored in accordance with Sections 3.1 and 3.2 above.
L327@P11: 4. Cycle life
L328@P11: 4.1 Cycle life performance
L329@P11: 4.1.1 Cell can be charged/discharged repeatedly up to times specified in the produce
L330@P11: specification with a certain level of capacity also specified in the product
L331@P11: specification.
L332@P11: 4.1.2 Cycle life may be determined by conditions of charging, discharging, operating
L333@P11: temperature and/or storage.
L334@P11: 5. Battery Pack Assembly
